sentences.text: 1. In respect of an accident in which the claimant has suffered injuries, the Tribunal has awarded Rs.4,68,615/- towards compensation.
2. The occurrence of the accident and the liability to pay compensation by the Insurer are not in dispute.
3. The Tribunal for awarding the said sum has assessed the whole body disability at 15% and has taken the notional income at Rs.7,000/-.
In my view, the assessment of disability at 15% cannot be found fault with.
4. However, since the accident is of the year 2016, it would be appropriate to determine the notional income of the claimant at Rs.9,500/- as fixed by the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority.

Consequently, the claimant would be entitled to a sum of Rs.2,90,700/- (Rs.9,500/- X 12 X '17' X 15%) towards 'loss of future earnings'.
6.

The Tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.1,34,415/-
towards 'medical expenses' and Rs.30,000/- towards 'future medical expenses'.
Since the same is based on medical evidence and the bills produced, it is just and proper and is accordingly affirmed.
7. The Tribunal has awarded Rs.30,000/- towards 'pain and sufferings' and has not awarded any sum towards 'loss of amenities'.
In my view, having regard to the extent of disability suffered by the claimant, it would be appropriate to award Rs.75,000/- and Rs.50,000/- respectively under the said heads.

8. The Tribunal has awarded Rs.30,000/- towards 'conveyance, food, nourishment and attendant charges', and Rs.30,000/- towards 'loss of earning NC: 2024:KHC:50784 during the period of treatment' in my view, the same are just and proper and are accordingly affirmed.

9. Consequently, the award of the Tribunal is modified and the following sums are awarded as compensation:

11. However, the claimant would not be entitled for interest for the delayed period.
12. The Insurance Company is directed to deposit the amount of compensation awarded within two months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.
13. The other aspects of the Award of the Tribunal remain undisturbed.
14. This appeal is, accordingly, allowed in part.
